topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the pages, hidden beneath the floorboard, words dancing in shadows I didn’t know existed. Each line, a mirror, twisted, reflecting moments I thought were ours alone. The room felt too small, the air thick with unspoken secrets. I moved, not knowing where to go, hands shaking with the weight of what I held. Outside, the world seemed too bright, too loud, mocking the silence that now filled the spaces between us. I didn’t know how to step back into the life we shared, not now, not with these pages whispering through my fingers.
